scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Moving past a slower or stopped vehicle or road user travelling in the same direction.
A person driving a motor vehicle on the road.
On a multilane road, the far left lane closest to the center divider, used to pass other vehicles.
A special area or lane on some two-lane roads into which slower vehicles merge to let vehicles behind them pass.
The part of the road set aside for pedestrians to cross, often marked with white (or yellow at schools) lines, which may also be unmarked.
Any place where one road meets another road.
An intersection where traffic travels in one direction around a central island.
A space set aside for pedestrians waiting for buses, streetcars, and trolleys.
A truck or other vehicle much larger than a passenger vehicle; the handbook gives no size threshold.
A rail vehicle, such as a light rail train, streetcar or trolley, operating on tracks on public roads.
A law enforcement manoeuvre in which an officer turns on their emergency lights and slowly weaves across lanes.
A lane in the middle of a two-way street, marked on each side by two painted lines, the inner broken and the outer solid.
A law enforcement vehicle, fire engine, ambulance, or other emergency vehicle.

rules.title: Judge space before passing near hazards
rules.when: approaching an oncoming vehicle or BICYCLIST OR a hill, curve, INTERSECTION, or road obstruction
rules.action: judge whether there is enough space to pass
rules.statement: WHEN approaching an oncoming vehicle or BICYCLIST OR a hill, curve, INTERSECTION, or road obstruction, the PASSER MUST judge whether there is enough space to pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time given for when the hazard counts as being approached

rules.note: The one-third-mile advice in 10.186 is GEN-02.

rules.title: Hill or curve at least one-third mile ahead
rules.when: planning to pass on a road with a hill or curve ahead
rules.action: pass
rules.unless: the hill or curve is at least one-third of a mile ahead
rules.statement: WHEN planning to pass on a road with a hill or curve ahead, the PASSER SHOULD NOT pass, UNLESS the hill or curve is at least one-third of a mile ahead.
rules.note: Handbook wording: 'To safely pass, the hill or curve should be at least one-third of a mile ahead.'

rules.title: Look ahead for conditions before passing
rules.when: about to pass
rules.action: look ahead for road conditions that may cause other vehicles to move into the PASSER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN about to pass, the PASSER MUST look ahead for road conditions that may cause other vehicles to move into the PASSER's lane.

vague_terms.term: road conditions that may cause other vehicles to move into the PASSER's lane

rules.title: Space to return to lane
rules.when: considering a PASS
rules.action: pass
rules.unless: there is enough space to return to the PASSER's original lane
rules.statement: WHEN considering a PASS, the PASSER MUST NOT pass, UNLESS there is enough space to return to the PASSER's original lane.

rules.title: Use the left lane to pass
rules.when: driving on a multilane road AND intending to pass
rules.action: use the PASSING LANE to pass
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a multilane road AND intending to pass, the PASSER SHOULD use the PASSING LANE to pass.
rules.note: Given as a tip for choosing a lane (10.32, 10.33), so recorded as ADVICE although 10.33 is worded as a command; 10.46 describes the far left lane as the lane used to pass. SIDE-01 allows passing on the right on an open highway with two or more lanes going the same direction. 10.33 says 'the left lane'; it is read here as the far left PASSING LANE defined in 10.46.

rules.title: Solid yellow line on your side: no passing
rules.when: there is only one lane of traffic going the DRIVER's direction AND a solid yellow line is on the DRIVER's side of the road
rules.action: pass a vehicle in front
rules.statement: WHEN there is only one lane of traffic going the DRIVER's direction AND a solid yellow line is on the DRIVER's side of the road, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass a vehicle in front.
rules.note: 10.6 introduces the single solid yellow centre line, but the prohibition is worded for any solid yellow line on the driver's side.

rules.title: Double solid yellow lines: do not cross
rules.when: the road has double solid yellow lines
rules.action: stay to the right of the double solid yellow lines and not pass over them
rules.unless: in a high-occupancy vehicle carpool lane with a designated entrance on the left OR instructed by construction or other signs to drive on the other side of the road because the DRIVER's side is closed or blocked OR turning left across a single set of double yellow lines to enter or exit a driveway or private road or make a U-turn
rules.statement: WHEN the road has double solid yellow lines, the DRIVER MUST stay to the right of the double solid yellow lines and not pass over them, UNLESS in a high-occupancy vehicle carpool lane with a designated entrance on the left OR instructed by construction or other signs to drive on the other side of the road because the DRIVER's side is closed or blocked OR turning left across a single set of double yellow lines to enter or exit a driveway or private road or make a U-turn.
rules.note: 'Pass over' here means drive across the lines; none of the exceptions allows crossing them to overtake. The figure shows an END DIVIDED ROAD / U-TURN OK situation.

rules.title: Broken yellow line: passing allowed when safe
rules.when: a broken yellow line is next to the PASSER's driving lane AND it is safe
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN a broken yellow line is next to the PASSER's driving lane AND it is safe, the PASSER MAY pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.note: Combines the permission with 'Only pass when it is safe'; the broken line does not restrict passing elsewhere.

rules.title: Double solid white lines: no lane change to pass
rules.when: there are double solid white lines next to the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: cross them to pass
rules.statement: WHEN there are double solid white lines next to the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT cross them to pass.
rules.note: Inferred: passing here means changing lanes, and 10.19 says never to change lanes over double solid white lines; wait until there is a single broken white line.

rules.title: No passing near a hill or curve without view
rules.when: approaching a hill or curve AND the PASSER cannot see if other traffic is approaching
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a hill or curve AND the PASSER cannot see if other traffic is approaching, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.
rules.note: The handbook adds that this is very dangerous on one and two lane roads.

rules.title: No passing within 100 feet of hazards
rules.when: within 100 feet of an INTERSECTION, bridge, tunnel, railroad crossing, or other hazardous area
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN within 100 feet of an INTERSECTION, bridge, tunnel, railroad crossing, or other hazardous area, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.

rules.title: No passing at crossroads and driveways
rules.when: at crossroads or driveways
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN at crossroads or driveways, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given for how near the crossroad or driveway the ban applies

rules.title: No passing a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk
rules.when: a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK
rules.action: pass the stopped vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the stopped vehicle.
rules.note: Reason given: you may not be able to see a pedestrian crossing the street.

rules.title: No passing in a roundabout
rules.when: travelling in a ROUNDABOUT
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN travelling in a ROUNDABOUT, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass.
rules.note: Same item also says do not stop in the roundabout.

rules.title: No passing in the center left turn lane
rules.when: on a road with a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE
rules.action: use the CENTER LEFT TURN LANE to pass
rules.statement: WHEN on a road with a CENTER LEFT TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the CENTER LEFT TURN LANE to pass.
rules.note: Inferred from 'It is not a regular traffic lane or passing lane' together with the instruction to use it only for left turns and U-turns.

rules.title: No passing where DO NOT PASS sign posted
rules.when: a do-not-pass sign is posted for the PASSER's direction of travel
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN a do-not-pass sign is posted for the PASSER's direction of travel, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.
rules.note: Rule shown only by the DO NOT PASS sign among the White Regulatory Signs in figure 12.89; 12.85, under the heading White Rectangular Sign, says these signs communicate 'many important rules you must obey'. The direction qualifier is inferred; the sign applies to the traffic it faces.

rules.title: How to pass on an open highway
rules.when: going to pass on an open highway
rules.action: signal the plan to pass, look over the shoulder to check blind spots, move into the lane used for passing, speed up to pass the vehicle, then signal and return to the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN going to pass on an open highway, the PASSER MUST signal the plan to pass, look over the shoulder to check blind spots, move into the lane used for passing, speed up to pass the vehicle, then signal and return to the original lane.
rules.note: 10.197 says 'the passing lane' without saying which lane on a two-lane road. The general lane-change checks (10.36-10.42) also apply to the moves out of and back into the original lane. On a freeway, 9.36 says to signal at least five seconds before changing lanes.

rules.title: Never leave the pavement to pass
rules.when: passing
rules.action: drive off the paved or main-traveled part of the road to pass
rules.statement: WHEN passing, the PASSER MUST NOT drive off the paved or main-traveled part of the road to pass.

rules.title: When passing on the right is allowed
rules.when: an open highway has two or more lanes going in the PASSER's direction OR the DRIVER ahead is turning left and the PASSER can safely pass on the right OR the PASSER is on a one-way street OR the PASSER is overtaking a LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN an open highway has two or more lanes going in the PASSER's direction OR the DRIVER ahead is turning left and the PASSER can safely pass on the right OR the PASSER is on a one-way street OR the PASSER is overtaking a LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE, the PASSER MAY ONLY pass on the right.
rules.note: The fourth case comes from 13.22, which forbids passing a LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE on the left in most cases (USER-05). USER-02 restricts this for a LARGE VEHICLE (pass it on the left, unless it is signaling a left turn). GEN-05 says to use the PASSING LANE to pass on a multilane road. MAY ONLY limits passing on the right to these cases; it does not restrict passing on the left.

rules.title: No passing on the left of a left-turning vehicle
rules.when: the DRIVER ahead is signaling a left turn
rules.action: pass on the left
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER ahead is signaling a left turn, the PASSER MUST NOT pass on the left.
rules.note: Applies to a LARGE VEHICLE too; USER-02 makes an exception for this case.

rules.title: Check a large vehicle's turn signals before passing
rules.when: following a LARGE VEHICLE AND before starting to pass it
rules.action: look at its turn signals
rules.statement: WHEN following a LARGE VEHICLE AND before starting to pass it, the DRIVER MUST look at its turn signals.
rules.note: Reason given: it may appear to be turning one way but be swinging wide in the opposite direction in order to turn.

rules.title: Pass large vehicles on the left
rules.when: passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: pass on the left side
rules.unless: the LARGE VEHICLE is signaling a left turn
rules.statement: WHEN passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST pass on the left side, UNLESS the LARGE VEHICLE is signaling a left turn.
rules.note: Worded 'Always pass a large vehicle on the left side.' Restricts SIDE-01: a LARGE VEHICLE is passed on the left even where SIDE-01 allows passing on the right. When the LARGE VEHICLE signals a left turn, SIDE-02 applies: do not pass on the left; pass on the right only where SIDE-01 allows. The exception is inferred from 10.202, which the handbook states for any driver ahead.

rules.title: Do not linger beside a large vehicle
rules.when: passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: move ahead of it after passing and not drive next to it longer than needed
rules.statement: WHEN passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST move ahead of it after passing and not drive next to it longer than needed.
rules.note: Reason given: driving alongside makes it hard for the large vehicle's driver to avoid dangers.

rules.title: Passing a stopped bus, streetcar or trolley
rules.when: a bus or LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE is stopped at a SAFETY ZONE or traffic light
rules.action: pass it at no more than 10 mph
rules.statement: WHEN a bus or LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE is stopped at a SAFETY ZONE or traffic light, the DRIVER MAY ONLY pass it at no more than 10 mph.
rules.note: MAY ONLY: passing is allowed only at no more than 10 mph; it does not require passing. The ban on driving through a SAFETY ZONE is USER-18. Does not apply to a school bus flashing its red lights; USER-20 requires stopping.

rules.title: No passing light rail or streetcar on the left
rules.when: overtaking a LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE, whether it is moving or standing
rules.action: pass it on the left side
rules.unless: the tracks are so close to the right side that the PASSER's vehicle cannot pass on the right OR the PASSER is on a one-way street OR a traffic officer directs the PASSER to pass on the left
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE, whether it is moving or standing, the PASSER MUST NOT pass it on the left side, UNLESS the tracks are so close to the right side that the PASSER's vehicle cannot pass on the right OR the PASSER is on a one-way street OR a traffic officer directs the PASSER to pass on the left.

vague_terms.term: so close to the right side

rules.note: SIDE-01's fourth case allows passing a LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE on the right, the side this rule leaves open.

rules.title: Never pass a motorcycle in the same lane
rules.when: a MOTORCYCLIST is in the same lane as the DRIVER
rules.action: try to pass the motorcycle in that lane
rules.statement: WHEN a MOTORCYCLIST is in the same lane as the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT try to pass the motorcycle in that lane.

rules.title: Passing a bicyclist by changing lanes
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST in the travel lane by changing to another lane
rules.action: pass safely, then return to the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST in the travel lane by changing to another lane, the PASSER MUST pass safely, then return to the original lane.
rules.note: Leaving space between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST is USER-19, which applies to every pass of a BICYCLIST.

rules.title: Three feet when passing a bicyclist in the same lane
rules.when: about to pass a BICYCLIST AND the PASSER cannot change lanes
rules.action: allow at least three feet between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST, and not pass until three feet of clearance can be given
rules.statement: WHEN about to pass a BICYCLIST AND the PASSER cannot change lanes, the PASSER MUST allow at least three feet between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST, and not pass until three feet of clearance can be given.
rules.note: 13.115 words it as a command; 10.71 says three feet 'must be maintained', so the stronger wording is recorded. Figure 10.70 shows a 3 FEET gap on a shared roadway.

rules.title: Do not squeeze bicyclists into parked cars
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST
rules.action: give the BICYCLIST enough space so the BICYCLIST is not forced into parked vehicles or open vehicle doors
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST, the PASSER MUST give the BICYCLIST enough space so the BICYCLIST is not forced into parked vehicles or open vehicle doors.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given; how much space depends on the parked vehicles and opening doors

rules.title: Care passing bicyclists on two-lane roads
rules.when: approaching or passing a BICYCLIST on a two-lane road
rules.action: be careful
rules.statement: WHEN approaching or passing a BICYCLIST on a two-lane road, the DRIVER SHOULD be careful.

rules.title: One danger at a time: oncoming vehicle and bicyclist
rules.when: on a two-lane road with an oncoming vehicle to the left AND a BICYCLIST ahead to the right
rules.action: slow down, let the oncoming vehicle pass, then move left to allow plenty of space (at least three feet) to pass the BICYCLIST, and not drive between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane road with an oncoming vehicle to the left AND a BICYCLIST ahead to the right, the DRIVER MUST slow down, let the oncoming vehicle pass, then move left to allow plenty of space (at least three feet) to pass the BICYCLIST, and not drive between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST.
rules.note: Given as a worked example of choosing between hazards, in plain commands.

rules.title: Steady oncoming flow when passing a bicyclist
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST on a two-lane road AND there is a steady flow of oncoming vehicles
rules.action: use as much of the left lane as the PASSER safely can
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST on a two-lane road AND there is a steady flow of oncoming vehicles, the PASSER MUST use as much of the left lane as the PASSER safely can.

vague_terms.explanation: no traffic density or gap length given

vague_terms.term: as much of the left lane as the PASSER safely can
vague_terms.explanation: amount not given; on a two-lane road the left lane is the oncoming lane, and how far into it is left to judgement

rules.note: Does not relax USER-08: if three feet cannot be given, do not pass the BICYCLIST (13.115).

rules.title: Follow a bicyclist at a safe distance
rules.when: behind a BICYCLIST in a travel lane who is not able to be passed
rules.action: follow at a safe distance
rules.statement: WHEN behind a BICYCLIST in a travel lane who is not able to be passed, the DRIVER SHOULD follow at a safe distance.
rules.note: The condition 'not able to be passed' is inferred: 13.108 follows the list of reasons a BICYCLIST may ride away from the right edge (13.101-13.107), and its next sentence asks the BICYCLIST to move so vehicles can pass.

rules.title: Bicyclist keeps right unless passing
rules.when: travelling slower than the flow of traffic
rules.action: ride as close as possible to the right curb or edge of the road
rules.unless: passing a vehicle or another bicycle going in the same direction
rules.statement: WHEN travelling slower than the flow of traffic, the BICYCLIST MUST ride as close as possible to the right curb or edge of the road, UNLESS passing a vehicle or another bicycle going in the same direction.
rules.note: 13.103-13.107 list further exceptions (preparing to turn left, avoiding a hazard, a lane too narrow to share, approaching a right turn, a one-way road with two or more lanes); they are outside the overtaking topic.

rules.title: Emergency flashers ahead: pass carefully
rules.when: a vehicle's emergency flashers are seen ahead
rules.action: slow down and, when going past the vehicle, pass carefully
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle's emergency flashers are seen ahead, the DRIVER MUST slow down and, when going past the vehicle, pass carefully.
rules.note: Reason given: there may be a collision or other road emergency.

rules.title: Move over and slow down for stopped emergency and work vehicles
rules.when: approaching a stationary EMERGENCY VEHICLE with flashing emergency signal lights (hazard lights) OR a stationary tow truck displaying flashing amber warning lights OR a stopped road work vehicle displaying emergency flashing or amber warning lights
rules.action: move over and slow down
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stationary EMERGENCY VEHICLE with flashing emergency signal lights (hazard lights) OR a stationary tow truck displaying flashing amber warning lights OR a stopped road work vehicle displaying emergency flashing or amber warning lights, the DRIVER MUST move over and slow down.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say how far or into which lane

rules.note: 13.47 is a plain command; 13.136 says drivers must, so recorded as REQUIREMENT. 13.137 could be read as amber lights qualifying both emergency vehicles and tow trucks; the emergency-vehicle light condition is taken from 13.47.

rules.title: Do not pass the patrol car during a traffic break
rules.when: a TRAFFIC BREAK is in progress ahead
rules.action: drive past the patrol vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a TRAFFIC BREAK is in progress ahead, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT drive past the patrol vehicle.
rules.note: Introduced with 'You should', so recorded as ADVICE. The same item adds 'Do not speed up until the officer turns off their emergency lights and traffic conditions allow you to return to your normal speed', which is about speed, not passing.

rules.title: Never drive through a safety zone
rules.when: approaching or passing a SAFETY ZONE
rules.action: drive through the SAFETY ZONE
rules.statement: WHEN approaching or passing a SAFETY ZONE, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive through the SAFETY ZONE.
rules.note: 13.18 says 'under any condition'. 13.18 says safety zones are marked by raised buttons or markers; 13.21 says dotted white lines.

rules.title: Leave space when passing a bicyclist
rules.when: passing a BICYCLIST
rules.action: leave space between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN passing a BICYCLIST, the PASSER MUST leave space between the vehicle and the BICYCLIST.
rules.note: Figures 13.111 (Right) and 13.113 (Wrong) show a car leaving room versus hitting the cyclist. USER-08 gives the three-foot minimum when the PASSER cannot change lanes.

rules.title: Do not drive past a school bus with flashing red lights
rules.when: a school bus ahead or approaching is flashing its red lights
rules.action: stop and remain stopped, not driving past the bus, until the children are safely across and the lights stop flashing
rules.unless: the school bus is on the other side of a divided or multilane highway with two or more lanes in each direction
rules.statement: WHEN a school bus ahead or approaching is flashing its red lights, the DRIVER MUST stop and remain stopped, not driving past the bus, until the children are safely across and the lights stop flashing, UNLESS the school bus is on the other side of a divided or multilane highway with two or more lanes in each direction.
rules.penalty: Fine up to $1,000 and possible one-year suspension.
rules.note: Worded in the handbook as a stop requirement; it applies from either direction (13.158). Applies even where USER-04 would allow passing a stopped bus at no more than 10 mph.

rules.title: Do not cut in front of a large vehicle after passing
rules.when: returning to the lane in front of a LARGE VEHICLE after passing it
rules.action: move in front of it and then suddenly slow down or stop, or change lanes directly in front of it to reach an exit or turn
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the lane in front of a LARGE VEHICLE after passing it, the PASSER MUST NOT move in front of it and then suddenly slow down or stop, or change lanes directly in front of it to reach an exit or turn.
rules.note: Reason given in 13.8: a large vehicle takes longer to stop and will not be able to stop fast enough to avoid a crash.

rules.title: Avoid passing in fog or heavy smoke
rules.when: driving in heavy fog or smoke
rules.action: cross lanes or pass traffic
rules.statement: WHEN driving in heavy fog or smoke, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT cross lanes or pass traffic, UNLESS absolutely necessary.

rules.title: Allow the pass; keep lane and speed
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the DRIVER OR signals that it plans to pass the DRIVER
rules.action: allow the vehicle to pass and maintain speed
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the DRIVER OR signals that it plans to pass the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST allow the vehicle to pass and maintain speed.
rules.note: Keeping lane position while being passed is BEING-10.

rules.title: Use turnouts to let traffic pass
rules.when: driving on a two-lane road with a TURNOUT AND cars are behind the DRIVER AND the DRIVER is slower than the cars behind
rules.action: merge into the TURNOUT to allow the cars behind to pass
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a two-lane road with a TURNOUT AND cars are behind the DRIVER AND the DRIVER is slower than the cars behind, the DRIVER MUST merge into the TURNOUT to allow the cars behind to pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no number of cars or following distance given

rules.note: Sign 10.66 reads SLOWER TRAFFIC USE TURNOUTS, which gives the slower-traffic condition. The legal requirement, with its thresholds (five or more following vehicles, passing unsafe), is BEING-03; this rule is the general instruction from 10.65.

rules.title: Turnout required with five or more following
rules.when: driving slowly on a two-lane road where passing is unsafe AND five or more vehicles are following the DRIVER
rules.action: use a TURNOUT to let the other vehicles pass
rules.statement: WHEN driving slowly on a two-lane road where passing is unsafe AND five or more vehicles are following the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST use a TURNOUT to let the other vehicles pass.
rules.note: The legal requirement; BEING-02 is the general instruction from 10.65 to merge into a TURNOUT when slower than the cars behind.

rules.title: Move right for faster drivers
rules.when: another DRIVER is close behind the DRIVER's vehicle AND that other DRIVER wishes to drive faster
rules.action: move to the right
rules.statement: WHEN another DRIVER is close behind the DRIVER's vehicle AND that other DRIVER wishes to drive faster, the DRIVER MUST move to the right.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say how the DRIVER ahead can tell what the following DRIVER wants
does not say how far or into which lane

rules.note: Same block: 'If you choose to drive slower than other traffic, drive in the right lane.'

rules.title: Let a tailgater pass
rules.when: a tailgater is behind the DRIVER
rules.action: create more space in front, maintain course and speed, then, when safe to do so, merge right into another lane and allow the tailgater to pass
rules.statement: WHEN a tailgater is behind the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST create more space in front, maintain course and speed, then, when safe to do so, merge right into another lane and allow the tailgater to pass.

vague_terms.term: a tailgater is behind the DRIVER
vague_terms.explanation: no following distance given for when a vehicle counts as tailgating

rules.title: Make room for passing motorcyclists
rules.when: a MOTORCYCLIST is passing the DRIVER's vehicle AND it is possible
rules.action: move to one side of the DRIVER's own lane to give the MOTORCYCLIST more room to pass
rules.statement: WHEN a MOTORCYCLIST is passing the DRIVER's vehicle AND it is possible, the DRIVER MUST move to one side of the DRIVER's own lane to give the MOTORCYCLIST more room to pass.
rules.note: 13.38 states that lane sharing with motorcycles (lane splitting) is legal. An exception to BEING-10's 'maintain lane position'.

rules.title: Bicyclist moves over to let vehicles pass
rules.when: vehicles are following the BICYCLIST AND it is safe
rules.action: move to a position that allows vehicles to pass
rules.statement: WHEN vehicles are following the BICYCLIST AND it is safe, the BICYCLIST SHOULD move to a position that allows vehicles to pass.

vague_terms.term: a position that allows vehicles to pass

rules.title: Pull over and stop for an emergency vehicle
rules.when: an EMERGENCY VEHICLE using a siren and red lights approaches
rules.action: drive to the right edge of the road and stop until every EMERGENCY VEHICLE has passed
rules.unless: the DRIVER is in an INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN an EMERGENCY VEHICLE using a siren and red lights approaches, the DRIVER MUST drive to the right edge of the road and stop until every EMERGENCY VEHICLE has passed, UNLESS the DRIVER is in an INTERSECTION.
rules.penalty: Failure to pull over may result in a ticket.
rules.note: Figure 13.45 shows a car pulling over to let a fire truck pass. In an INTERSECTION, BEING-09 applies.

rules.title: Emergency vehicle while in an intersection
rules.when: the DRIVER is in an INTERSECTION AND the DRIVER sees an EMERGENCY VEHICLE using a siren and red lights
rules.action: continue through the INTERSECTION, then drive to the right as soon as it is safe and stop until every EMERGENCY VEHICLE has passed
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in an INTERSECTION AND the DRIVER sees an EMERGENCY VEHICLE using a siren and red lights, the DRIVER MUST continue through the INTERSECTION, then drive to the right as soon as it is safe and stop until every EMERGENCY VEHICLE has passed.

vague_terms.term: as soon as it is safe

rules.note: REQUIREMENT because 13.44 makes giving the right-of-way to an emergency vehicle a duty with a ticket for failing to pull over; 13.48 gives what to do in an intersection.

rules.title: Keep lane position when being passed
rules.when: another vehicle is passing the DRIVER OR signals that it plans to pass the DRIVER
rules.action: maintain lane position
rules.unless: the passing vehicle is a motorcycle AND it is possible to move to one side of the lane
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing the DRIVER OR signals that it plans to pass the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST maintain lane position, UNLESS the passing vehicle is a motorcycle AND it is possible to move to one side of the lane.
rules.note: For a passing motorcycle, BEING-06 applies (13.41). BEING-05 covers a tailgater: keep course and speed, then merge right when safe.
